values.note: Up to 7 nights on one site and 14 nights in the park, then 48 hours away. Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends are a 3-night minimum (not July 4). Cancel by phone; no refund inside 7 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.co.dodge.wi.gov/lrp-parks/faqs ('can be made online up to a year in advance'; 'Campers may stay a maximum seven (7) nights per site and a total of 14 nights per reservation group at each individual park'; 'There is a three (3) night minimum for Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends')

note: Dodge County park on the west shore of Beaver Dam Lake, a few minutes NW of Beaver Dam. The campsites sit in wooded loops west of County Road CP; the boat launch, canoe/kayak launch, picnic area and fish-cleaning station are across the road on the lakeshore. --Claude
